pages.text: Health 128, Attack 16.5, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Armor 8, Toughness 1, Movement Speed 0.25.$(br)Having made yourself an iron ally, you turned to the notion of a furnace as a golem's core. Some research later, the Furnace Golem stood up.
Place a $(l)Vitality Pumpkin$() on the central $(l)Reinforced Blast Furnace$().

In its ordinary state it is all but identical to an iron golem, but when you strengthen it with fuel its furnace blazes and unlocks more abilities.$(br)You can use an $(item)Iron Ingot$() on it to heal it.
